caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wall-mounted object, primarily in golden yellow and brown tones. On the left, there is a large, shallow bowl with intricate openwork patterns along the rim and sides, resembling a decorative metal basket or sconce. The bowl tapers down to a small, rounded base which connects to a horizontally oriented, elongated arm. This arm is decorated with geometric and linear details, joined at a right angle to a rectangular wall plate on the right side. The wall plate is also elaborately decorated with symmetrical patterns and has a pointed finial at the top. Below the arm, there is a diagonal supporting brace attached to the main arm and ending in a decorative circular element. The entire object is rendered with detailed shading to highlight its three-dimensional form and ornate surface textures. The background is plain and uncolored. The name “John H. Tercuzzi” is inscribed in small letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Lamp Bracket
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
